profile.headline: I’m a self-employed web developer — I create websites for businesses and individuals, handling both the design and technical side.
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer | Freelance Designer & Digital Solutions Expert
profile.summary: As a self-employed website developer, I specialize in creating custom, responsive websites tailored to each client’s unique vision and goals. From concept to launch, I handle all aspects of development, including front-end design, back-end functionality, SEO integration, and ongoing support. Working independently has given me the freedom to collaborate closely with clients, ensuring each project is personal, efficient, and effective. With a strong focus on usability and aesthetics, I aim to deliver websites that not only look great but also perform well.

positions.title: Web Developer | Freelance Designer & Digital Solutions Expert
positions.description: Experienced in designing, developing, and maintaining custom websites for small businesses, entrepreneurs, and personal brands. Skilled in front-end and back-end development, responsive design, SEO optimization, and client-focused solutions. Successfully manage all aspects of business, including client communication, project management, and marketing.
positions.insights: Front-End Development, Front-end Coding and +20 skills

positions.title: City Letter Carrier
positions.description:
Mail carrier for the Baltimore area. 

Delivers and collects mail on foot or by vehicle under varying road and weather conditions in a prescribed area; maintains professional and effective public relations with customers and others, requiring a general familiarity with postal laws, regulations, products and procedures commonly used, and geography of the area.
positions.insights: Interpersonal Skills, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and +4 skills

positions.title: Clinical Assistant
positions.description:
The Clinical Assistant provides direct care and supervision of patients admitted to the Inpatient Neurobehavioral Unit, implements written behavioral and educational protocols, and collect data on patient-specific target behaviors.

The Clinical Assistants work with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities admitted to the inpatient NBU for treatment of severe problem behavior.

volunteerExperiences.description:
its a camp for children 7 1/2 - 12 with asthma 
overnight stay for 6 days 
i supervise a group of 6-10 kids 
we educate the kids on how to take care of themselves and their asthma

I was a volunteer Camp counselor for a week long over night asthma camp. The camp was directed by Bayview Respiratory Therapists. The camp was centered around teaching children what asthma is, how to manage it, and how it affects the body.
